data.name: Mesmeric Mirror
data.description: An illusory image appears near the subject to throw off attackers. The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject is attacked or becomes the target of a spell that requires an attack roll. %1 duplicate(s) of the subject appears, and the attacker must determine randomly which it hits (as mirror image). Each image lasts for %2 minute(s) or until destroyed. This is an illusion (figment) effect.|min(1+MesmeristLVL/5,5)|MesmeristLVL
